Reviewed the uncommitted implementation against baseline 9bb84c6437bd4b38f928defcaad0ec678fa24a5e, including the listed source, schema, tests, examples, contracts and necessary consumers.

Findings: none. Optional suggestions: none.

Ownership is coherent: src/ergora/definition_bundles.py shares package verification and immutable publication between real Agent and Workflow consumers; src/ergora/workflow_definitions.py retains graph, port, inheritance, permission and budget semantics. Existing public Agent operations and legacy workflow forwarding remain intact.

The traversal preserves structural ancestry, complete material and deduplication provenance, distinguishes repeated references, rejects conflicting resource identities/loading names, and checks permissions and budgets through every active ancestor. Backup verification resolves cross-library references. Preview explicitly returns executable=false and pending runtime checks.

SP-1/SP-2 remain valid historical findings. Current _permissions rejects partial definition scopes and noncanonical network origins for definitions and explicit grants; the added tests cover rejection and supported inputs. ST-1 is addressed by referencing the root version rule.

Read author evidence under .ergora/checks/ac3d-workflows/: r1-expanded-source-tests.log and r1-wheel-tests.log report 177 passed/8 skipped; r2-source-tests.log and r2-wheel-tests.log report 144 passed/2 skipped. Both r1-build-final.log and r2-build.log end successfully. package-identities.json records 359 matching package files and 283 frozen files; r1-cli-journey.json and r2-cli-journey.json record 26 expected exits and preserved references/material. These are author evidence, not independently rerun checks. Windows and fixed-SDK skips establish no acceptance for those operations.

Inspection was read-only, without project execution or delegation. Live git diff/log and independent hash commands failed with a sandbox mount error; source reads and branch/status inspection succeeded. Identity conclusions therefore rely on the supplied manifest and named evidence.
